_comment: 'The money, in human terms' items. Only amounts quoted in a cited source. per_person_* fields are computed by `python3 _tools/plain.py money` (do not edit by hand). Never add figures from different scopes together. A comparison pictures the size of an amount; it is not a bill each person pays.
